level_four.title: Battle Hunger
level_four.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

level_seven.title: Flash of Anger
level_seven.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 (+4% per level) point Shield for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Wrath of the Angiris
level_ten.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving. level_thirteen.title: Pathetic Mortals
level_thirteen.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Swiftness
level_sixteen.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero Stunned with Celestial Charge.

level_twenty.title: Brand of Solarion
level_twenty.description: Reduce the duration of Valorous Brand to 5 seconds, but it is no longer consumed when triggered.

level_one.title: Mana Addict
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

level_four.title: Nether Wind
level_four.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

level_seven.title: Sun King's Fury
level_seven.description: Living Bombs that have spread to enemy Heroes deal 35% more damage.

level_ten.title: Phoenix
level_ten.description: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84 (+4% per level) damage and splashing for 42 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Fission Bomb

level_sixteen.title: Ignite

level_twenty.title: Flamethrower
level_twenty.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Dishonorable Discharge

Mythic Reward: After 75 stacks, its number of strikes is increased by 2 and the final strike Stuns for 1.25 seconds.

level_four.title: Static Shield

level_seven.title: Thunderstrikes

level_ten.title: Mighty Gust
level_ten.description: Push enemies away, and Slow them by 40%, decaying over 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Charged Up

level_sixteen.title: Afterburner

level_sixteen.title: Eager Wolf

level_twenty.title: Unleashed

level_seven.description: Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time. level_thirteen.description: Every 45 seconds, gain 70 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

Mythic Reward: After 75 stacks, its number of strikes is increased by 2 and the final strike Stuns for 1.25 seconds.

level_four.title: Static Shield
level_four.description: Lightning Rod strikes grant a Shield equal to 4% of Falstad's maximum Health, up to 28%, for 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Charged Up
level_seven.description: Increases Lightning Rod range by 25%. Hero Takedowns reset Lightning Rod's cooldown.

level_ten.title: Mighty Gust
level_ten.description: Push enemies away, and Slow them by 40%, decaying over 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Thunderstrikes
level_thirteen.description: Lightning Rod deals 25% more damage each subsequent strike.

level_sixteen.title: Afterburner
level_sixteen.description: Barrel Roll increases Movement Speed by 60%, decaying over 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Wind Tunnel
level_twenty.description: Mighty Gust creates a wind tunnel for 4 seconds. Enemies caught in the tunnel will periodically be pushed back.

level_one.title: Creed of the Hunter
level_one.description: Quest: Every 50 Basic Attacks against Heroes increases Hatred's damage bonus per stack by 1%, up to 6%.  Gambit: Gain 25% bonus Attack Speed. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

level_four.title: Death Dealer
level_four.description: Increase Vaults Basic Attack damage bonus from 6% to 15% per stack of Hatred. If this attack kills its victim within 1.5 seconds, the Mana cost and cooldown of Vault are refunded.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Vault by 5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Hot Pursuit
level_seven.description: Increase the Movement Speed bonus of each stack of Hatred from 1% to 2%.

level_ten.title: Rain of Vengeance
level_ten.description: Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Tempered by Discipline
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks heal for 10% of the damage dealt, increased by 2% per Hatred stack.

level_sixteen.title: Manticore
level_sixteen.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_one.title: Recklessness
level_one.description: While Zul'jin is below 75% Health, he gains 10% Spell Power. While he is below 50% Health, his Basic Attack damage is increased by 10% and Basic Attacks against Heroes grant an additional stack of You Want Axe?.

level_four.title: Voodoo Shuffle
level_four.description: Activate to remove Roots and Slows.  Passive: Lower the cooldown and Mana cost of Regeneration by 40%.

level_seven.title: Ferocity
level_seven.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Berserker by 40%.

level_ten.title: Taz'dingo!
level_ten.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

level_thirteen.title: Eye of Zul'jin
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant Zul'jin 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%.

level_sixteen.title: Let the Killing Begin
level_sixteen.description: When Zul'jin kills an enemy, his Attack Speed is increased by 5%, up to 40%, for 12 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration.  Hero Takedowns instantly grant 40% Attack Speed.

level_twenty.title: A Surprise For Ya
level_twenty.description: Basic Attacks bounce to a nearby enemy for 50% damage, prioritizing enemy Heroes.

level_four.title: Pursuit of Justice
level_four.description: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Hand of Protection
level_seven.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Divine Storm
level_ten.description: Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Well Met
level_thirteen.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Benediction
level_sixteen.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Redemption
level_twenty.description: After Eternal Vanguard ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health.  This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

level_one.title: Burn The Impure
level_one.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level_four.title: Battle Hunger
level_four.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

level_seven.title: Flash of Anger
level_seven.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 (+4% per level) point Shield for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Angelic Armaments
level_ten.description: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.  If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

level_thirteen.title: Pathetic Mortals
level_thirteen.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Swiftness
level_sixteen.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero Stunned with Celestial Charge.

level_one.title: Covert Ops
level_one.description: After being Stealthed for 2 seconds, Pinning Shot's Slow is increased to 60% and costs no Mana. Bonus is lost after losing Stealth for 1 second.

level_four.title: Covert Mission
level_four.description: Enemy Minions killed near Nova grant a stack of Bribe. Hero Takedowns grant 10 stacks of Bribe. Use 25 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum of 100 stacks. If a camp is defeated entirely with Bribe, the camp respawns 50% faster.

level_seven.title: Anti-Armor Shells
level_seven.description: Nova's Basic Attacks deal 250% damage and decrease the Physical Armor of Heroic targets by 15 for 4 seconds, but her Attack Speed is proportionally slower.

level_ten.title: Triple Tap
level_ten.description: Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.

level_thirteen.title: Double Tap
level_thirteen.description: Pinning Shot now has 2 charges, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Crippling Shot
level_sixteen.description: Pinning Shot lowers a Hero's Armor by 20 for the duration of the Slow, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

level_one.title: Swift as the Wind
level_one.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Swift Strike increases Genji's Movement Speed by 40% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Shuriken Mastery
level_four.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Shuriken.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Shuriken damage is increased by 25.  Reward: After hitting 60 Heroes, Cyber Agility now refunds 3 charges of Shuriken.

level_seven.title: Perfect Defense
level_seven.description: Deflected damage reduces the cooldown of Deflect by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 12 seconds.

level_ten.title: Dragonblade
level_ten.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Shingan
level_thirteen.description: Hitting an enemy with all 3 Shuriken deals 100 (+4% per level) bonus damage. Deals 40% less damage to Structures.

level_sixteen.title: Reflect
level_sixteen.description: Deflect also deals an additional 33% of the damage blocked.
